topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: It's a bit surprising, hearing that my childhood best friend doesn't recall me. Yet, I find myself thinking about all the times we spent together, the games we played, and the secrets we shared. Maybe it's not about the memory, but about the warmth those memories bring to me. I can reach out, not to remind or to make them feel guilty, but to perhaps rekindle that connection, to build new memories together. After all, what matters is the journey forward, not just the past. I'll send a gentle message, maybe share a photo or two, and see where the conversation leads.
